<!--
  The order summary card of the cart page and the checkout: the lines in short (optional), a promo code field
  with ready codes, the free-delivery progress, the totals, the button and a note. Static markup.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Promo, CartSummaryLabels } from "./cart-summary-card.types";
import type { CartLine } from "../blocks/cart-list.types";
import type { SummaryRow } from "../blocks/order-summary.types";

export type CartSummaryCardProps = {
  lines: CartLine[];
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  promos: Promo[];
  labels: CartSummaryLabels;
  items?: "show" | "hide";
  promo?: "show" | "hide";
  progress?: "show" | "hide";
  value?: number;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import Input from "../primitives/input/input.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Progress from "../primitives/form/progress.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  lines,
  rows,
  promos,
  labels,
  items = "hide",
  promo = "show",
  progress = "show",
  value = 70,
} = defineProps<CartSummaryCardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Stack gap="6" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-testid="summary">
    <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between">
      <Title :as="2" size="lg" weight="semibold">
        {{ labels.title }}
      </Title>
      <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ tpl(labels.items, ((lines?.length ?? 0) == null ? undefined : String((lines?.length ?? 0)))) }}
      </Text>
    </Group>
    <List v-if="((items as string) === 'show')" tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-4" data-testid="summary-lines">
      <ListItem v-for="line in lines" :key="line.id" class="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
        <MediaFrame :alt="line.name" ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0" />
        <Stack gap="0" class="flex-1">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ line.name }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl("{0} x {1}", line.qty, fmtMoney(line.price, line.currency)) }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Inline class="font-medium">
          {{ fmtMoney((line.price * line.qty), line.currency) }}
        </Inline>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
    <Stack v-if="((promo as string) === 'show')" gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="promo">
      <Group gap="2" align="center">
        <Input type="text" name="promo" :aria-label="labels.promo" :placeholder="labels.promo" class="min-w-0 flex-1" />
        <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button">
          {{ labels.apply }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
      <Group gap="2" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ labels.codes }}
        </Text>
        <Badge v-for="c in promos" :key="c.id" variant="outline" size="sm" data-testid="code">
          {{ c.code }}
        </Badge>
      </Group>
    </Stack>
    <Stack
      v-if="((progress as string) === 'show')"
      gap="2"
      align="stretch"
      class="rounded bg-muted p-4"
      data-testid="progress"
    >
      <Text size="sm">
        {{ labels.progress }}
      </Text>
      <Progress :value="(value == null ? undefined : String(value))" max="100" :aria-label="labels.progress" />
    </Stack>
    <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <ListItem v-for="row in rows" :key="row.id"
        :class="cn(
          'flex items-center justify-between gap-4',
          (
            row.strong ? 'border-t border-border pt-4 text-base font-bold'
            : 'text-sm text-muted-foreground'
          )
        )"
        data-testid="row"
      >
        <Inline>
          {{ row.label }}
        </Inline>
        <Inline>
          {{ fmtMoney(row.amount, row.currency) }}
        </Inline>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
    <Button variant="default" size="lg" class="w-full" data-testid="checkout">
      {{ labels.checkout }}
    </Button>
    <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {{ labels.note }}
    </Text>
  </Stack>
</template>
